events.title: 아스널 go top of the Premier League with a 1–0 win at Charlton.
Dave Bassett becomes director of football at 레스터 시티 and he hands managerial duties over to his assistant Micky Adams .
맨체스터 시티 returned to Premiership after only a season out after 울버햄프턴 원더러스 suffered a 1–0 away defeat at 밀월.

레스터 시티 's relegation is confirmed as they lost 1–0 at home to 맨체스터 유나이티드 , whose crucial win keeps their title challenge alive. 아스널 remain in the lead with a 2–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. A relegation crunch game at the Reebok Stadium sees Bolton beat 입스위치 타운 4–1, with Fredi Bobic scoring a hat-trick. 맨체스터 시티 secured the Division One title after thrashing 반즐리 5–1 at Maine Road.
웨스트브로미치 앨비언 clinch promotion to the FA Premier League with a 2–0 win over 크리스털 팰리스 which ends their 16-year exile from the top flight.

April draws to a close with 아스널 top of the Premier League with 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 리버풀 still in contention, while 레스터 시티 and 더비 카운티 have both been relegated. 입스위치 타운 occupy the last relegation place but will need to win their final game of the season and hope that 선덜랜드 lose theirs if Premier League football is to be played at Portman Road and not the Stadium of Light next season.
